name: iBorShell
description: iBorShell: a secure SSH terminal for DBX — interactive sessions, SFTP file transfer, multi-host exec, clone session and live server stats. Fork of jinpy's Terminal plugin.
releaseNotes: iBorShell 1.0.2: new plugin logo (transparent PNG artwork). All platform packages are Ed25519-signed (key_id net.iborshell). Feature set unchanged from 1.0.0: fork of jinpy's Terminal (io.dbx.ssh 0.7.9-beta.2) repacked as net.iborshell — Multi Exec panel, Clone Session, live CPU/ping/disk stats strip; command history panel removed.
